objectives.label: Dobro, hvala. Denver je danes miren.
objectives.descriptorEN: Say how the dogs are today.

objectives.label: Prosim, ne dajte mu hrane.
objectives.descriptorEN: Turn down a treat and say why.

objectives.label: Temu lahko, tistemu pa ne.
objectives.descriptorEN: Allow something for one dog, not the other.

objectives.label: Tega raje ne, prosim.
objectives.descriptorEN: Stop another dog from coming up to yours.

n1.speaker: npc
n1.en: Good day! How are the boys?

c1a.speaker: client
c1a.sl: Dobro, hvala. Denver je danes miren.
c1a.en: Fine, thanks. Denver is calm today.
c1a.deliverySL: [toplo] Dobro, hvala. Denver je danes miren.

c1b.speaker: client
c1b.en: Denver is a bit nervous today.

n2c.speaker: npc
n2c.sl: Ah, moja je v redu, samo stara je že. Kaj pa Denver, kako je danes?
n2c.en: Oh, mine's fine, she's just getting old. And Denver, how is he today?
n2c.deliverySL: [toplo] Ah, moja je v redu, samo stara je že. Kaj pa Denver, kako je danes?

n2a.speaker: npc
n2a.sl: Super, potem lahko moja pride bliže. Pridi sem! Joj, Enzo je pa spet živahen!
n2a.en: Great, then mine can come closer. Come here! Oh, Enzo's lively again!
n2a.deliverySL: [toplo] Super, potem lahko moja pride bliže. Pridi sem! Joj, Enzo je pa spet živahen!

c2a.speaker: client
c2a.en: Yes, he just wants to play.

n2b.speaker: npc
n2b.sl: Potem pa svojo raje držim pri sebi. Ostani tukaj!
n2b.en: Then I'd better keep mine by me. Stay here!
n2b.deliverySL: [toplo] Potem pa svojo raje držim pri sebi. Ostani tukaj!

c2b.speaker: client
c2b.sl: Hvala. Včasih je nervozen ob drugih psih.
c2b.en: Thanks. He's sometimes nervous around other dogs.
c2b.deliverySL: [toplo] Hvala. Včasih je nervozen ob drugih psih.

n3.speaker: npc
n3.sl: Glejte, piškote imam. A jih lahko dam fantoma?
n3.en: Look, I've got biscuits. Can I give some to the boys?
n3.deliverySL: [toplo] Glejte, piškote imam. A jih lahko dam fantoma?

c3a.speaker: client
c3a.sl: Prosim, ne dajte jima hrane. Denver je bil pred kratkim operiran.
c3a.en: Please don't give them food. Denver had an operation recently.
c3a.deliverySL: [toplo] Prosim, ne dajte jima hrane. Denver je bil pred kratkim operiran.

c3b.speaker: client
c3b.en: This one can, but not that one.

n4a.speaker: npc
n4a.sl: Joj, škoda. Seveda, revček. Potem jih pa kar pospravim.
n4a.en: Oh, a shame. Of course, poor thing. I'll just put them away, then.
n4a.deliverySL: [toplo] Joj, škoda. Seveda, revček. Potem jih pa kar pospravim.

n4b.speaker: npc
n4b.sl: Na, Enzo! Ha, kar pogoltnil ga je. Kaj pa Denver — kaj mu pa je?
n4b.en: Here, Enzo! Ha, he just gulped it down. And Denver — what's the matter with him?
n4b.deliverySL: [toplo] Na, Enzo! Ha, kar pogoltnil ga je. Kaj pa Denver — kaj mu pa je?

nW.speaker: npc
nW.sl: Ubogi kosmatinec! Pa tako lep je.
nW.en: Poor furry thing! And he's so handsome.
nW.deliverySL: [toplo] Ubogi kosmatinec! Pa tako lep je.

nWa.speaker: npc
nWa.sl: Kosmatinec je pes z veliko dlake — kot vaš Denver.
nWa.en: A 'kosmatinec' is a dog with lots of fur — like your Denver.
nWa.deliverySL: [toplo] Kosmatinec je pes z veliko dlake — kot vaš Denver.

nWb.speaker: npc
nWb.sl: Mislim — ubogi Denver. Dober pes je.
nWb.en: I mean — poor Denver. He's a good dog.
nWb.deliverySL: [toplo] Mislim — ubogi Denver. Dober pes je.

nWc.speaker: npc
nWc.deliverySL: [počasi in razločno, potrpežljivo] Kos … ma … ti … nec. Kosmatinec.

nDog.speaker: npc
nDog.sl: Ups, glejte — moja bi ga rada pozdravila!
nDog.en: Oops, look — mine wants to say hello to him!
nDog.deliverySL: [toplo] Ups, glejte — moja bi ga rada pozdravila!

cD2.speaker: client
cD2.sl: Lahko se povohata, danes je miren.
cD2.en: They can sniff each other, he's calm today.
cD2.deliverySL: [toplo] Lahko se povohata, danes je miren.

cD3.speaker: client
cD3.sl: Lahko se povohata, danes je miren.
cD3.en: They can sniff each other, he's calm today.
cD3.deliverySL: [toplo] Lahko se povohata, danes je miren.

nD1.speaker: npc
nD1.sl: Oh, oprostite! Pridi sem! No, jaz moram naprej. Se vidimo!
nD1.en: Oh, sorry! Come here! Well, I have to go on. See you!
nD1.deliverySL: [toplo] Oh, oprostite! Pridi sem! No, jaz moram naprej. Se vidimo!

cZ1.speaker: client
cZ1.en: No harm done. Bye, have a nice day!

nByeA.speaker: npc
nByeA.en: Thanks, same to you. Till tomorrow!

nD2.speaker: npc
nD2.sl: Glejte ju — že sta prijatelja! No, midve greva naprej. Se vidimo!
nD2.en: Look at them — friends already! Well, the two of us are off. See you!
nD2.deliverySL: [veselo] Glejte ju — že sta prijatelja! No, midve greva naprej. Se vidimo!

cZ2.speaker: client
cZ2.en: Well done, Denver! Bye, have a nice day!

nD3.speaker: npc
nD3.sl: Ups! Dobro, dobro, potem pa greva naprej. Se vidimo!
nD3.en: Oops! All right, all right, we'll go on then. See you!
nD3.deliverySL: [toplo] Ups! Dobro, dobro, potem pa greva naprej. Se vidimo!

cZ3.speaker: client
cZ3.sl: Oprostite! Včasih je nervozen ob drugih psih. Adijo!
cZ3.en: Sorry! He's sometimes nervous around other dogs. Bye!
cZ3.deliverySL: [toplo] Oprostite! Včasih je nervozen ob drugih psih. Adijo!

nByeC.speaker: npc
nByeC.en: No harm done, don't worry. Bye!

c2ax.speaker: client
c2ax.sl: Oprostite, držim ga. Še mladiček je.
c2ax.en: Sorry, I'm holding him. He's still a puppy.
c2ax.deliverySL: [toplo] Oprostite, držim ga. Še mladiček je.

c2bx.speaker: client
c2bx.sl: Hvala, ampak Enzo je prijazen. Lahko se povohata.
c2bx.en: Thanks, but Enzo is friendly. They can sniff each other.
c2bx.deliverySL: [toplo] Hvala, ampak Enzo je prijazen. Lahko se povohata.

c4ax.speaker: client
c4ax.en: You can give Enzo some, though.

n2aH.speaker: npc
n2aH.en: Oh, I know him, the little wild one.

n2bE.speaker: npc
n2bE.sl: No, prav, samo z malim. Pridi, ampak lepo!
n2bE.en: Well, all right, only with the little one. (to her dog) Come on, but nicely!
n2bE.deliverySL: [toplo] No, prav, samo z malim. Pridi, ampak lepo!

n4aE.speaker: npc
n4aE.sl: Na, Enzo! Tebi pa ne, Denver, žal.
n4aE.en: Here, Enzo! Not you, Denver, sorry.
n4aE.deliverySL: [veselo] Na, Enzo! Tebi pa ne, Denver, žal.

n4bS.speaker: npc
n4bS.sl: Aha, plašen. Zato se drži bolj ob strani.
n4bS.en: Ah, shy. That's why he keeps to the side.
n4bS.deliverySL: [toplo] Aha, plašen. Zato se drži bolj ob strani.

nWaE.speaker: npc
nWaE.sl: Enzo? Enzo je mali razbojnik, Denver je pa pravi gospod.
nWaE.en: Enzo? Enzo's a little rascal, but Denver is a real gentleman.
nWaE.deliverySL: [veselo] Enzo? Enzo je mali razbojnik, Denver je pa pravi gospod.

nWbN.speaker: npc
nWbN.sl: Saj vem. Ampak z mojo se lepo razume.
nWbN.en: I know. But he gets on well with mine.
nWbN.deliverySL: [toplo] Saj vem. Ampak z mojo se lepo razume.
